title: First & FirstOrDefault
description: Learn to retrieve the first element from collections using First and FirstOrDefault.

data.text: The `First` and `FirstOrDefault` methods return the first element from a collection, or the first element that satisfies a condition.
The `First` method returns the first element of a collection. If the collection is empty or no element satisfies the condition, it throws an `InvalidOperationException`.

data.title: First Examples

data.text: The `FirstOrDefault` method returns the first element, or the default value if the collection is empty or no element satisfies the condition.

data.title: FirstOrDefault Examples
Null Elements
data.text: Be careful with null elements. FirstOrDefault may throw an exception when evaluating a condition on a null element.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: First returns the first element or first matching element
First throws InvalidOperationException if no element found
FirstOrDefault returns default value instead of throwing
data.takeaway: Continue to the next lesson to learn about Last and LastOrDefault.
